name: Gauntlet of Terror
description: Prevent Strahd's Monsters from leaving the dungeon and attacking the village.

objectives.description: Defeat 20 Monsters before too many escape the dungeon.

specialRules.description: When the active Hero moves within 1 tile of a face-down Monster token, flip it and place 0-3 Monsters accordingly.
Monsters move toward the Start tile. When a Monster ends a Villain Phase on the Start tile, it escapes and removes 1 Hit Point from the Start tile.
Place 5 HP tokens on the Start tile. If all are removed (5 monsters escape), the adventure is lost.

introText: The Heroes must stop Strahd's monsters from reaching Barovia.
victoryText: The monsters lie slain! Barovia is safe from Strahd's invasion.
defeatText: Too many monsters escape into Barovia. The village falls to Strahd's darkness.
